name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm
description: Dev-time minimal functional stand-in for the dsh-advisor plugin repo. The real package is private (not on the npm registry) and ships from the host dsh app at runtime; this stub mirrors the consumed contract surface of the dsh-private packages/llm/llm seam (merge-extensible MessageSourceMap / ContentBlockMap, Message/UserMessage shapes, frozen message creators, the stream chunk + failure vocabulary, and the LlmService/LlmAdapter service shape) and implements just enough behavior for real-composition tests. Mirrors dsh-private commit b8343cb (2026-08-09 snapshot).
